analysis.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents Sunday Sky's Rendering as a Service (RAS) platform. 1) Request & Playlist Generation Flow (Flow 0): Client devices initiate requests for personalized videos via API Gateway. API Gateway routes requests to the RAS Frontend Lambda, which validates requests and pushes rendering instructions into the SQS Jobs Queue. The Rendering EC2 Spot Instances pull jobs from the queue when capacity allows, immediately responding with playlist information to the SQS Responses Queue. The RAS Frontend Lambda fetches this response and returns the playlist link to the client device. 2) Video Rendering & Streaming Flow (Flow 1): Rendering EC2 instances render video segments and upload them to S3. Client devices request playback through CloudFront, which caches and serves video segments from S3. 3) Dynamic Auto-Scaling Flow (Flow 2): Rendering EC2 instances publish custom metrics to CloudWatch. Step Functions triggers the Scaling Lambda every 15 seconds to evaluate load and scale the Auto Scaling Group accordingly. 4) Spot Interruption Management Flow (Flow 3): Upon receiving a Spot Interruption Notice via CloudWatch Events, the Interruption Handler Lambda calls an API on the rendering EC2 instance to stop pulling jobs and drain active tasks before detaching the instance from the Auto Scaling Group.

Batch Flow: Expedia Group feeds data (heterogeneous formats like Parquet, JSON, CSV) into an ingestion S3 bucket (Data Lake). analysis.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture depicts a data ingestion and NLP enrichment pipeline built by Tandem. An account update event triggers an ingest Lambda via Kinesis Data Streams. The ingest Lambda queries raw transaction data from an RDS instance, batches transaction description strings, and pushes them to an SQS queue. The SQS queue decouples ingestion from high-throughput NLP processing, fanning out messages to scale out worker Lambda functions running Antler-generated Python NLP parsers. Once enriched, the worker Lambda writes processed transaction details along with model metadata back to another RDS table for forward-thinking auditability, and concurrently emits a completion event to a downstream Kinesis stream for downstream consumption.
